items.title: Fastly Just Dropped 41% in a Month: Is FSLY Stock Dead Money or Due for a Bounce?
items.summary: Fastly beat estimates, raised guidance and still watched investors dump the stock for the third straight earnings report. Behind the record revenue sit a rising customer concentration problem and a sales chief heading for the exit.

items.title: Did Broad Layoffs Just Shift Comcast's (CMCSA) Investment Narrative?
items.summary: Comcast is cutting staff and reshaping its organization while continuing to roll out multi gigabit broadband, mobile and security services across several new U.S. markets, including Barrington, Franklin, rural Indiana counties and Tulare County. The combination of layoffs tied to customer losses and heavy network investment highlights Comcast's effort to rebalance costs against long term connectivity demand.
